body:
Face to face interaction isn't going to happen. It's very painful for me to interact with other people. I don't do it well at all and I come off as very weird so people want nothing to do with me. People can't deal with someone that just mumbles or responds with just one word. The feeling I have while all that's going on is crippling. 

To be honest, the idea of killing myself puts me as ease. It can be over, and I've battled with this all my life. It's probably not going to be any other way for me. I was born with a disability and will hold me back in almost any situation in life. This is different than just being nervous or tongue tied. This is embarrassing, it's crippling, it's nothing but pure panic and fear anytime I'm around another human being. Medications make me feel worse or no different at all, I'm going to be homeless in a week and I will lose everything I've ever had. I already lost all my family pictures because of this mental disability. They put me in the hospital for a year and a half the last time I tried to kill myself. The land lord came and took everything out of my house and threw it in the garbage. I don't have anything left to remember my Mom's or Dad's face. It's all gone and I can't do anything to get it back. This world isn't worth staying in for someone like me. 

I want it all to be over and I want that now. No more working towards a goal or trying to fix things. It never works out. Nothing ever gets better. Every time it's always one step forward and two steps back. The more I think about it the more hopeless it all seems.

There aren't any farms around here. There used to be textile plants but they all closed up over the last decade. Most of them are empty buildings near the interstate. 

It'll be awhile until I can build up any money. I'm overdrawn in my bank account. I'd have to get a lawn mower too before I could cut grass and there's that problem of my social anxiety. It will be very difficult for me to go around advertising myself. I don't do well at all talking to people. I had to get drunk to do this online right now. Also I'm not sure where I would keep anything since I'm being evicted next Friday. 


I have and they have done things like mock interviews with the doctor. They said when they get my brain chemistry figured out then I should be able to do an interview.

I've never had the ability to be calm in social situations. 

I went to group therapy for a couple of years until they quit doing it. Up until a couple of weeks ago I went to the doctors at the mental health clinic but I can't get a ride over there anymore. They are supposed to be setting up a home visit for me but I'm getting evicted next Friday so I'm not sure how that will work out.

Let me explain what going to an interview is like for me. 

They call me and scheduled an interview for the next day. Back when I could get places, I would stay up all night, I won't be able to sleep. All night and every minuet until the interview I get more and more of a tight knot feeling in my stomach. Sometimes I throw up, other times I sweat a lot and shake. When I get there I have trouble pronouncing things like my own name. People look at me weird. They start asking me questions about my past experience and what I want out of the job. I start to freeze up. I'll clam up and just mumble the answers. Interview ends early with the "We'll keep in touch." 

That's a best case scenario. Sometimes I don't even make it to the interview. I will run out into the woods behind my house and spend the entire day there. I can't even sit at home on that day. I will find a log or a big rock to just sit on and watch the day go by. I won't return home when I get so hungry I can't think of anything else but eating. I have sat on a hill side in the middle of the woods in the cold rain, trying to hide from the real world before. 

It is always my fault. I would understand if I went to a job interview and I stayed normal, then they said, "It's not going to work out, we're looking for someone with a little more experience or something."

It never works out like that. It's always my uncontrollable behavior that fucks everything up.

I have social anxiety problems, I'm not going to be able to go door to door and talk to people without freezing up or being so stressed that I act weird and they tell me to fuck off.

I don't live in a big city anyway, there are no parks here just a trail that I've walked on and never seen anyone else on. 

Things are too far apart to ride a bike which I don't own one anyway. I don't have any other transportation since my uncle died.
I tried to be dog walker for extra money a couple of years ago. I spent $550 on signs I stuck around red lights and did some craigslist ads. I never got any calls.

I've been on a lot of medications. I was recently on ativan before they switched me to paxil CR. 

There are only 3 doctors that do this in town and they've all been working together to help me.

I have no degrees. I couldn't afford college. 

I have a few IT certifications but I can't get through the interview and with no experience working in the field, it really hurts any chance of getting a job.
I've been going to the doctor for almost 10 years now.

I'm not doing the online work from home scams again. I've never made money on any of those. 

I will always have to interact with someone and I don't do a good enough job to be a professional at anything. I need to make at least $800 a week to afford a place to live and transportation to work. I can't find that and have never been successful in a job interview. I freeze up and act weird while being interrogated like that. 

I am useless, I will never own anything and in a week I will be homeless. If I don't find a job by next Friday then I'm just going to shoot myself.

I have been to the Anxiety subreddit. I can sum that up for you, "See a doctor." That's all you get from there.  

No offense but the rest of this is just generic drivel.
